facts.fact: OPM's Director of Architecture said government has already saved about N$16 million on social grants through electronic identity verification, including preventing payments to deceased beneficiaries.

Officials said the E-ID will let different government systems share verified identity information and that government is developing authentication tools, standards and support so businesses including SMEs can use the E-ID infrastructure, with rollout set for September 2026.
facts.system: E-ID authentication tools for government and business systems

systems.owner: Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security; Office of the Prime Minister

note: The 2026-07-25 date is the document's published date; the source gives no earlier date for the grants saving.
